_comment: Prioritized work queue for the autonomous loop. Policy: security/bug first, then improvement/chore, then feature; within a tier lower P-number wins, ties FIFO by createdAt. Discovery agents append here. Selection is deterministic via scripts/ralph/lib/backlog.mjs (tested). Status: todo | in_progress | done | blocked.

items.title: Verify the full gate is green on the working branch and fix any red step

items.title: LLM cost-guard blind to roadmap/cv/briefings — unlimited free-tier LLM calls
items.rationale: POST /api/roadmap/:id/generate (4000 max-tokens, SSE), POST /api/cv/mine/generate and POST /api/briefings/generate have no costGuard and no freemium check; any authenticated free user can call them unlimited. Root cause: costGuard reads monthly spend from aiCostLogTable (populated only by recordAiCall in ai-wendy.ts + wiki-telemetry.ts), but these routes call recordLlmUsage → deprecated llmUsageTable, which cost-guard.ts:57 says it no longer reads.
acceptance: Reproduce + confirm root cause (which routes write llmUsageTable vs aiCostLogTable)
Add costGuard (or a freemium monthly gate) to the roadmap/cv/briefings generate routes
Make their spend visible to the monthly counter (switch to recordAiCall, or sum both tables in costGuard)
Gate stays green

items.title: Fix N+1 in account.ts getUserRelatedData (+ FK indexes on messages/conversations)
items.rationale: apps/server/src/routes/account.ts fetches all conversations then fires one SELECT per conversationId (N+1) on the /account/export path. messages.conversationId and conversations.userId are query hot-paths with no DB index. Replace the loop with a single inArray() and add the two indexes.
acceptance: getUserRelatedData fires exactly 1 query for messages (inArray), not N
messages adds index on conversationId; conversations adds index on userId (schema)
Gate green; /account/export returns identical shape (no regression)

items.blockedReason: Discovery design is FK-invalid: linkedRagChunkId has a hard FK to rag_chunks.id, so a news-article id cannot be stored there for dedup (would crash on insert — verified in proactiveInsight.ts). Needs a design decision (add a linkedNewsArticleId column + FK, or dedup heuristically on userId+type+recent-window) AND a real-DB integration test (no DATABASE_URL in the loop env). Also requires a sector ID→name join (users have preferredSectorIds:int[], news has sectorNames:text[]). Founder/design call — do not one-shot.

items.rationale: Vision (AaaS 'signal-when-it-matters'): proactive-insight-generator.ts handles weak_signal (skill_gap/news are stubs). insightType enum already has 'news'. BUT the discovery's dedup-via-linkedRagChunkId is wrong (that column FK-references rag_chunks, not news_articles). Build deferred until the link/dedup design is chosen and a non-prod DB is reachable for the integration test.
acceptance: generateNewsInsights() added and called in runProactiveInsightGenerator()
Matches news published in last 7 days to user.preferredSectorIds via sectorNames[] overlap; ≤1 news insight/user/run; respects MAX_UNREAD_PER_USER
Dedup: skip if a non-dismissed insight with the same linkedRagChunkId exists
Mock-free unit test for the sector-matching logic; gate green
